items.desc: The European Union wants to relax rules for pesticides, saying it will be easier for farmers to adopt more environmentally friendly options. But health and environmental experts say the risks are far too great.

items.title: India news: CJP leaders Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka released from Tihar Jail
items.titleOrig: India news: CJP leaders Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka released from Tihar Jail
items.desc: The two Cockroach Janta Party leaders were released after pledging not to call for protests at Delhi's Jantar Mantar amid demonstrations demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation. DW has more.

items.desc: Soon after Putin and Zelenskyy expressed willingness to resume US-mediated talks, Russia and Ukraine traded major attacks on each other's capitals.

items.title: Austrian, Swiss women kidnapped in Niger are freed — report
items.titleOrig: Austrian, Swiss women kidnapped in Niger are freed — report
items.desc: An Austrian woman and a Swiss woman kidnapped in Niger have been freed after 18 months in captivity, local reports say.

items.title: US orders some diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia amid Houthi threat
items.titleOrig: US orders some diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia amid Houthi threat
items.desc: The US State Department has asked some US diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia because of the threat of Houthi attacks on the Gulf kingdom.

items.title: Pope Leo will not need further cancer treatment — Vatican
items.titleOrig: Pope Leo will not need further cancer treatment — Vatican
items.desc: Pope Leo's lung cancer surgery last week was a success, the Vatican said. The pope broke with traditions of secrecy around papal health issues after announcing he needed surgery to remove a nodule on his lung.

items.title: German youth plan France-style mass protests
items.titleOrig: German youth plan France-style mass protests
items.desc: A youth-led movement in Germany has called for demonstrations in major cities of the country on October 31. The group has categorically distanced itself from the violence that took hold in France.

items.title: France bans protests in parts of Paris as Macron slams Trump
items.titleOrig: France bans protests in parts of Paris as Macron slams Trump
items.desc: French President Emmanuel Macron railed against "stupid" comments made by foreign leaders for their political purposes. Plus, Paris police are set to extend restrictions on gatherings in parts of the city on Thursday.

items.title: Germany news: AfD's Weidel calls for major EU reforms
items.titleOrig: Germany news: AfD's Weidel calls for major EU reforms
items.desc: Far-right Alternative for Germany co-leader Alice Weidel reveals the party's plan to reform the EU. Meanwhile, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was in Berlin to talk to developers and investors. DW has more.

items.title: Trump, Putin and Xi at one table, without Ukraine. What Moscow wants from the proposal and why Beijing might agree.
items.titleOrig: Trump, Putin and Xi at one table, without Ukraine. What Moscow wants from the proposal and why Beijing might agree.
items.desc: Moscow is pushing for a summit with Donald Trump and Xi Jinping to discuss ending the war in Ukraine, without Kyiv or the EU. What does Russia hope to gain, and why might China be willing to take part?

items.title: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion in Cambridge Analytica case
items.titleOrig: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion in Cambridge Analytica case
items.desc: A New Mexico judge ordered Facebook's parent company, Meta, to pay $25 billion for misleading users over the Cambridge Analytica breach, which took place during Donald Trump's first presidential campaign.

items.title: PHP developers say key patches available after global scare
items.titleOrig: PHP developers say key patches available after global scare
items.desc: Newly discovered vulnerabilities in the PHP programming language have put millions of websites at risk, with government agencies sounding alarms and taking down sites. Developers say updating systems is "imperative."

items.title: Raids at far-right group's offices at European Parliament
items.titleOrig: Raids at far-right group's offices at European Parliament
items.desc: Authorities searched the Patriots for Europe's European Parliament offices in a long-running funding inquiry. The group says the charges pertain to its predecessor and there is "no legal continuity" between the two.
